params.localChainSelector: the chain selector of the chain this contract is deployed to.

curse(bytes16[]).details: reverts if any of the subjects are already cursed or if there is a duplicate.

returns.localChainSelector: the chain selector, not the chain ID.

isBlessed((address,bytes32)).details: This function is only expected to be used for messages from CCIP versions below 1.6.

returns._0: bool true if there is an active global curse.

params.subject: To check whether a particular chain is cursed, set to bytes16(uint128(chainSelector)).

returns._0: bool true if the provided subject is cured *or* if there is an active global curse.

setConfig((bytes32,(address,uint64)[],ui.details: setting config is atomic; we delete all pre-existing config and set everything from scratch.

params.to: The address to which ownership will be transferred.

uncurse(bytes16[]).details: reverts if any of the subjects are not cursed or if there is a duplicate.

params.merkleRoots: must be well formed, and is a representation of the CommitReport received from the oracles.
params.offRampAddress: is not inferred by msg.sender, in case the call is made through RMNProxy.
params.signatures: rmnNodes ECDSA sigs, only r & s, must be sorted in ascending order by signer address.

acceptOwnership().notice: Allows an ownership transfer to be completed by the recipient.

getCursedSubjects().notice: gets the current set of cursed subjects.

getLocalChainSelector().notice: Returns the chain selector configured at deployment time.

getReportDigestHeader().notice: Returns the 32 byte header used in computing the report digest.

getVersionedConfig().notice: Returns the current configuration of the contract and a version number.

isBlessed((address,bytes32)).notice: Callers MUST NOT cache the return value as a blessed tagged root could become unblessed.

isCursed().notice: If there is an active global or legacy curse, this function returns true.

isCursed(bytes16).notice: If there is an active global curse, or an active curse for `subject`, this function returns true.

setConfig((bytes32,(address,uint64)[],ui.notice: Sets the configuration of the contract.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Allows an owner to begin transferring ownership to a new address. The new owner needs to call `acceptOwnership` to accept the transfer before any permissions are changed.

verify(address,(uint64,bytes,uint64,uint.notice: Verifies signatures of RMN nodes, on dest lane updates as provided in the CommitReport.
